question:
Find the volume (in cm³, rounded to the nearest integer) of a sphere of radius 7 cm.

(Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the formula for the volume of a sphere: V = 4/3 × π × r³

⇒ V = 4/3 × 22/7 × 7³

⇒ V = 4/3 × 22 × 49

⇒ V = 4312 / 3 = 1437.33...

Rounding to the nearest integer gives 1437.

**∴ The correct answer is 1437 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 7 cm

Value of π ≈ 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere (V) = 4/3 × π × r³

 
 
 
 
• 
 r = 7 cm
 Volume = 4/3 × π × r³

**Calculations:**

⇒ V = 4/3 × 22/7 × (7)³

⇒ V = 4/3 × 22/7 × 343

⇒ V = (4 × 22 × 49) ÷ 3

⇒ V = 4312 ÷ 3

⇒ V = 1437.33... cm³

Rounding to the nearest integer, we get 1437 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1437 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is strictly curved and given by the formula: A = 4 × π × r²

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Its volume is calculated as: V = 2/3 × π × r³

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r²
